articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as tech slides ahead of Nvidia earnings
articles.description: ZEC and HYPE led a quiet bounce in altcoins, while Nasdaq futures extended a two-day rout and traders waited on U.S. retail sales.

articles.title: Hackers plant crypto-stealing code on 178 major websites, including HSBC and Ledger
articles.description: An Optimizely signup flaw let an attacker plant address-swapping code on websites including HSBC, the BBC and Ledger. The total stolen remains unknown, and investigators have not linked the attack to AI.

articles.title: Nvidia faces first earnings test without Jensen Huang as AI stocks slide
articles.description: With shares almost 40% below their October peak, Nvidia’s guidance could carry more weight than quarterly results as investors assess its direction without Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
articles.description: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

articles.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
articles.description: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation seeks $5 million from treasury using ADA price 33% above market
articles.description: The Foundation wants 25 million ADA for 12 global events, even as the token trades well below the 20 cent price used to size the request.

articles.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
articles.description: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.

articles.title: Ripple-backed Evernorth has written down its pre-listing XRP holdings by 60%
articles.description: The company’s accounting policy requires it to record price declines without reversing those write-downs when XRP recovers.

articles.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
articles.description: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto selloff
articles.description: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

articles.title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
articles.description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

articles.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
articles.description: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
articles.description: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

articles.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
articles.description: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

articles.title: Solana drops ‘beta’ label after more than six years
articles.description: The blockchain is getting a shared version number. Wallets, transactions and apps remain unchanged.

articles.title: Old crypto feud reignites: Why OKX's Star Xu blames Binance for two years of October crashes
articles.description: CZ says Binance isn’t selling crypto and he has been buying. OKX founder Star Xu accuses him of misleading customers about the exchange’s role in successive October crashes.

articles.title: Bitcoin was supposed to gain as AI faltered, but it crashed. Here's why.
articles.description: The price action runs counter to a crypto-market view that a cooling AI trade would trigger a rotation into digital assets and spark a rally.

articles.title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border payments to reduce settlement risk
articles.description: Zero-knowledge proofs let each ledger verify the other leg was locked, so neither currency settled unless both did, with no shared ledger or intermediary.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips after rebounding from July 14 low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations
articles.description: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.6% since midnight UTC at around $64,300, after falling to $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since July 14, as traders await Nvidia earnings.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $65,000 as Nasdaq closes with 2.5% loss
articles.description: Strategy and Strive might be the only buyers left in BTC, and each — constrained by weak stock prices — made only modest purchases last week.

articles.title: FOMC minutes, Nvidia earnings, Russia’s retail crypto rules: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 16.

articles.title: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
articles.description: DBS and JPMorgan have connected their blockchain-based deposit networks, letting approved clients move tokenized U.S. dollars between Singapore and the U.S. at any time, including weekends.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin flips to ‘total bull’ on a faster route to quantum-safe Ethereum
articles.description: A proposed system would combine bulky digital signatures into a shared proof, helping protect wallets without making every payment much more expensive.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners were hijacked and their BTC rewards redirected to an attacker
articles.description: Luxor said just over a dozen customers were affected and will be reimbursed after their machines were redirected to another mining pool.

articles.title: Cardano holders vote down $5 million bid to buy warehouse copper
articles.description: Toto Finance’s 22 million ADA treasury request expired Sunday with about 20 million ADA in favor, and none of Cardano’s seven constitutional committee members voted yes.
